data.revised_prompt: Create a high-quality 3D chibi-style educational app avatar of a fictional Chinese schoolgirl, age 8–14, healthy, natural, friendly. Single character only. Square 1:1 composition. Tight head-focused portrait, front view or slight 2/3 view. The face and hair together occupy about 75%–85% of the canvas; only a very small amount of shoulders and neck visible at the bottom, definitely not a half-body or upper-body portrait. Full hair silhouette visible, not cropped at the top, sides, or chin. Straight medium-length hair with neat curtains bangs, a thin narrow bright yellow headband. Calm, focused closed-mouth smile. Bright brown eyes. Soft studio lighting, smooth refined modeling and materials, clearly a student, not an adult or teacher. Bottom shows only a small bit of white school collar, no logo, no text. Background must be a solid full-bleed light aqua green that fills the entire square to the edges and corners, with no white border, no transparency, no frame, no ring, no halo, no scene elements. High contrast, readable at small sizes, simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal details, crisp and clean. Avoid: half-body, upper body, full body, hands, props, teacher, adult, earphones, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, top crop, hair crop, chin crop, face too small, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular background, avatar frame, ring, halo, complex scene, text, letters, numbers, school badge, logo, watermark, multiple characters, real photo, flat 2D illustration, infant proportions, dark tones, low resolution, distorted facial features.
